nodes.klein: to be or remain behind. he was late, tarried (a hapax legomenon in the Bible, occurring Gen. 32:5 in the form וָאֵחַר). he delayed, tarried; he caused one to delay, kept back. he was late. he came late. he delayed, postponed. was delayed, postponed.

nodes.g: to put to shame, be ashamed, be disconcerted, be disappointed
